description: What brand names is this drug sold under? Lists the US brand names whose products contain a generic ingredient (e.g. simvastatin: Zocor, Vytorin, Flolipid), with RxCUI codes, from the U.S. National Library of Medicine RxNorm. Useful for travellers, carers and anyone comparing US and UK medicine names. Brands are US only (UK-only brands are not listed), the list includes combination products containing the ingredient, and it does not say which brands are currently marketed. (cost: 1 credit)

generic.description: string, required, the generic ingredient name (e.g. "simvastatin")

name: drug_brand_names
